subject: feelings
title: Meet the feelings
summary: Look for clues in faces, sort feelings into baskets and think about how someone might feel.

items.label: happy
items.fact: A smile can be a clue that someone feels happy.
items.clue: A friend arrives and Amani smiles and jumps for joy. How might she feel?

items.label: sad
items.fact: Someone who feels sad might cry or want a little quiet time.
items.clue: Sam misses a friend who moved away and tears roll down his face. How might he feel?

items.label: angry
items.fact: Someone who feels angry might frown or feel tense. They can pause and take a breath.
items.clue: Someone knocks over Leo's tower on purpose. He frowns and his body feels tight. How might he feel?

items.label: loved
items.fact: When someone cares for us, we might feel loved.
items.clue: A grown-up listens, gives Amani a hug and tells her they care about her. How might she feel?

items.label: worried
items.fact: When we keep thinking that something might go wrong, we may feel worried.
items.clue: Sam keeps thinking something could go wrong on his first day at a new school. How might he feel?

items.label: calm
items.fact: Slow breaths and a quiet place help some people feel calm.
items.clue: Leo is sitting quietly, breathing slowly and feeling relaxed. How might he feel?

items.label: sleepy
items.fact: Yawning or rubbing our eyes can be signs that we feel sleepy.
items.clue: It is bedtime. Sam yawns, rubs his eyes and struggles to keep them open. How might he feel?

items.label: surprised
items.fact: Something unexpected can make us feel surprised.
items.clue: A box opens and an unexpected balloon floats out. Amani's eyes open wide. How might she feel?

items.label: confused
items.fact: We might feel confused when we do not understand what is happening.
items.clue: Leo is given directions that do not make sense to him. He does not know which way to go. How might he feel?

items.label: confident
items.fact: Feeling confident means believing you can have a go.
items.clue: Sam has practised and believes he is ready to try the challenge. How might he feel?
